name: prefix
description: Fetch full Bioregistry metadata for a biological database prefix (e.g. "chebi", "hpo", "uniprot"), including canonical URI pattern, synonyms, homepage, and cross-registry mappings.

name: search
description: Search Bioregistry for biological database prefixes by substring match against prefix name, title, or description (e.g. "gene ontology"). Returns up to `limit` matching prefix records.

name: resolve
description: Resolve a CURIE (prefix:id) to a provider URL.

name: prefixes
description: Paginate over all registered Bioregistry prefixes (2,000+); returns full prefix records for each entry. Use limit/offset to page through the complete registry.
